info.name: EdhDeckBuilder — API Exploration
info.description:
Manual exploration of the Scryfall and EDHREC APIs used by EdhDeckBuilder.Infrastructure.

Change the collection variables at the top to explore different commanders and cards:
  - `commander_slug`  The EDHREC slug (see rule below)
  - `card_name`       Exact or fuzzy name for Scryfall lookups

EDHREC slug rule: lowercase, spaces and hyphens become hyphens, commas/apostrophes/punctuation stripped.
  Korvold, Fae-Cursed King  →  korvold-fae-cursed-king
  Atraxa, Praetors' Voice   →  atraxa-praetors-voice
  Edgar Markov              →  edgar-markov

variable.description: EDHREC slug for the commander you want to explore.
Card name for Scryfall named-card lookups.

item.name: Scryfall
item.description:
Official Scryfall API — documented at https://scryfall.com/docs/api
Be polite: Scryfall asks for 50–100 ms between requests.

Note: do NOT run 'Download oracle_cards bulk file' from Postman — the file is ~250 MB and Postman will time out or run out of memory. It is here only so you can inspect the manifest and copy the download_uri.

request.description:
Returns a list of all available bulk-data files.
ScryfallBulkClient calls this first to resolve the oracle_cards download_uri.

Look for the entry where type == 'oracle_cards'. Its download_uri is the large file the client downloads. The updated_at field shows when Scryfall last rebuilt it (usually daily).

Returns one card whose name matches exactly. 404 if no exact match.

Use this to inspect the raw JSON shape a card has in the oracle_cards bulk file:
  - type_line (what ScryfallMapper parses for CardType flags and IsLegendary)
  - color_identity (the string array FromScryfall() converts)
  - legalities.commander (what drives CommanderLegality and CanBeCommander)
  - image_uris vs card_faces[0].image_uris (DFC layout)
  - mana_cost null on lands; card_faces[0].mana_cost on split/DFC cards
Tolerates partial names and typos — returns the closest match. Handy when you are unsure of punctuation or exact spelling.

Full Scryfall query syntax. Returns paginated results (up to 175 per page).
Useful for verifying how many cards CardRepository.SearchAsync() should plausibly return for a given substring — the repository does a simple case-insensitive Contains(), not Scryfall's query syntax.

A double-faced card — useful for verifying the DFC fallback logic in ScryfallMapper.

Expect: top-level mana_cost and image_uris are null; card_faces[0] carries the front-face mana_cost, type_line, oracle_text, and image_uris instead.
ScryfallMapper.ToCard() falls back to card_faces[0] for all those fields.

item.name: EDHREC
item.description:
Unofficial EDHREC JSON API at json.edhrec.com — undocumented and may change.

Slug derivation matches EdhrecSlugger.FromCard():
  1. Lowercase the full card name
  2. Keep a–z, 0–9; replace spaces AND hyphens with a single hyphen
  3. Strip everything else (commas, apostrophes, punctuation)
  4. Collapse consecutive hyphens

Examples:
  Korvold, Fae-Cursed King  →  korvold-fae-cursed-king
  Atraxa, Praetors' Voice   →  atraxa-praetors-voice
  Edgar Markov              →  edgar-markov
  Kenrith, the Returned King→  kenrith-the-returned-king

Response shape that matters for EdhrecMapper:
  container.json_dict.cardlists[]
    .header          — section name ("Ramp", "High Synergy Cards", etc.)
    .cardviews[]
      .name            — card name (must resolve in CardRepository)
      .num_decks       — how many decks include it
      .potential_decks — total comparable decks
      inclusion = num_decks / potential_decks

request.description:
The primary data source — maps to SuggestionSource.GetRecommendationsAsync().
Cached by EdhrecClient at {CacheDirectory}/{commander_slug}.json with a 7-day TTL.

Tip: look at the 'High Synergy Cards' section — it has the highest-signal cards for this specific commander, often stronger than the universally popular ones in 'Top Cards'.

Maps to SuggestionSource.GetAverageDeckAsync().
Cached at {CacheDirectory}/avg-{commander_slug}.json (different key from the commander page).

Contains a representative 99-card deck. Good sanity check: all card names here should resolve in CardRepository. Any that don't are either very new cards (not yet in the Scryfall bulk cache) or EDHREC using a slightly different name spelling.
Hardcoded example for Atraxa, Praetors' Voice — one of the most popular commanders. Useful as a reference for what a large, well-populated response looks like (many sections, high card counts).

Deliberately invalid slug — should return 404.
EdhrecClient catches this as HttpRequestException with StatusCode.NotFound and returns null. SuggestionSource then returns an empty candidate list and logs a warning.
